run_train_dreambooth: run dreambooth training on a pretrained diffusion model with scheduled huber loss and optional prior preservation
parse_dreambooth_args: parse dreambooth training arguments from command line with support for loss types, huber scheduling, and prior preservation
create_dreambooth_dataset: create a DreamBoothDataset that prepares instance and class images with tokenized prompts for model fine-tuning
compute_conditional_loss: compute conditional loss using l2, huber, or smooth_l1 reduction between model prediction and target
log_validation_images: log validation images generated from the trained dreambooth pipeline to tensorboard or wandb
